# Introduction
{{"template":"referral","ordinal":"second","of":"self"}} is the second release of {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod / to_base:to_base"}}. The previous release was {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_base:0.0.1","short":true}}, and the following release is {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_base:0.0.3","short":true}}{{"template": "version_release"}}.

This release contains no content, but the GitHub repository was changed from a single-mod to a multi-mod project. GitHub Actions for the repository to automatically build and release the mod were also introduced.

The dependency on Architectury for multi-platform modding was removed, in favor of {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:to_base"}} handling multiple modloaders via service providers.
